properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): the Shop sample reached its building model with summer cooling, structural loads and the food goal's sufficiency never worked out, and nothing in reflow2 said so, because "complete" was never defined for the design (no closure criterion, so closure_report offers no verdict), reflow2's detectors check only the intent already recorded and cannot see a kind of intent that was never recorded, and the work order came from phase briefs rather than from reflow2's own loop
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause), 2026-10-25, on Anthony's words: "part of reflow2 design is seeing all the gaps and making sure all the requirements work together. This can't be me reminding you, 'I want a complete design'. The reflow2 design should automatically drive to a complete design." Job 3 of reflow2:dec:idea-reflow2-does-fewer-things-and-does-them-really-well is "find what's structurally missing or contradictory ... and ask you in plain questions".
① OBSERVED on the Shop sample (flo2 design 671a764fa790c030, 2026-10-25, during Phase D2):
- Summer cooling is only an annual energy allowance (2,303 kWh, inside con:assumed-phase-c-building-assemblies-airtightness-and-equipment); no peak cooling load was computed for a site that passes 100 F.
- Snow and wind loads were never read.
- The food goal is "a family of four's summer vegetables and some fruit year-round", with no total of what that supplies.
- loop_status: 87 gaps never put to the person; 34 decisions whose chains read unconfirmed; 17 undischarged assumptions.
Anthony found these by asking, not because the design told him.
② PRECEDENT: vocabulary_coverage's own description ("vocabulary a design never touched is invisible to every other computation"); the gap source closure_criterion_undeclared; reflow2:fact:root-cause-a-dated-real-world-event-has-no-typed-date-2026-10-25 (a missing kind of record).
③-⑤ CANDIDATES, each with the measurement that could refute it:
(C1) "complete" is undefined for this design. Refuted if closure_report gives a verdict. MEASURED: closure_report says "no_closure_criterion_stated", with traceability 0 of 88 requirements closed and budgets 19 of 21. Its gap, closure_criterion_undeclared, is 1 of 92 open gaps, at low severity. SURVIVES.
(C2) the detectors see only recorded intent, and a kind of intent never recorded is invisible. Refuted if a gap names summer cooling, structural loads or food sufficiency. MEASURED: detect_gaps lists 92 gaps by source (unrealized_capability 57, reasoning_not_as_stated 17, understated_status 4, and one each of 14 other kinds), and none concerns them. search_design finds no requirement for summer indoor comfort and none for structural loads. The one cooling capability ("Heat the shop zone ... and cool it in summer") carries no number, and no limit bounds summer indoor temperature, so there is no budget to breach. SURVIVES.
(C3, outside reflow2: the process) the work order came from phase briefs, not from reflow2's loop. MEASURED on flo2.io's call log for this design (1,495 calls over 2 days): detect_gaps was called 21 times, gap_to_prompt once, what_next and open_questions never, and set_closure_criterion never. The sessions' phases (A requirements and parts, B limits, C analysis, D model) were set in the coordinator's briefs, and so were the analyses each phase did. SURVIVES.
(C4) the signal is buried. 57 of the 92 gaps are "nothing builds capability X", expected while the design is still a design, and they sort beside the 17 undischarged assumptions, which matter more. A contributor.
(C5) the observation is wrong, and cooling was computed. REFUTED: only an annual allowance exists, from an assumed constraint.
⑥ CLASS: reflow2 drives a design to be consistent with what it was told, not to be complete for what it is. Completeness needs two things it does not have unless someone supplies them: (a) the owner's definition of done (a closure criterion), which nothing asks for at the start; and (b) a model of what a design of this KIND must answer (for a building: structure, envelope, heating AND cooling, egress, fire separation, energy code, water, waste, power). reflow2 is domain-neutral by design, so a kind of intent nobody recorded stays invisible. And when sessions follow someone's phase plan instead of reflow2's own loop (closure, then what_next, then ask), even the gaps it does see wait. Fix options are with Anthony. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
